reviews.text: I love this place for my two furbabies. I mean it's gotten a little more pricey since but definitely well worth it for two dogs. I have recommended this place to others.

Kristy is also great with cats....my very old, very matted cat, who let's no one brush her, got "the works" today....shave and manicure! Somehow Kristy and her assistant got this job done and Ms Lady is now strutting about like a movie star, - happy, and so much more comfortable!

I’ve recently lost one of my cats in December because of a groomer; I was scared to take my other cat to the groomers since. I was very reluctant but knew that she had to be groomed. The staff were all very welcoming and understanding. The owner, Cristy was extremely gentle and reassured me that my cat was safe with her. Indeed she was. The entire process i felt confident that my cat was going to be okay and is in reliable hands. I will be coming back to the Paw Parlor every time to groom my cat! Thank you to the staff and the incredible owner for talking such good care of my cat and of me.
I like my dog shaggy, but when he needs to look like a gentleman, I'll only bring him here

My dog was groomed today and I’m very satisfied. When I picked him up the groomer said he did great, which was a relief. This is his 3rd grooming here and he always comes back looking good and smelling even better. Whatever products they use lasts because he smells good for atleast 2 weeks.
I was very happy with the service my Bella received her first time there and Bella has herself a new groomer. So glad I heard about this place from a friend

So happy I found my Rocky a new groomer . It can be difficult to find groomers who can handle a large breed but they were diligent, kept me updated throughout the process, on time and reasonably priced . Most importantly for me, they did Rocky’s nails wonderfully and weren’t scared to trim them. Would recommend and will continue to bring Rocky back. Thank you!
I have a 3 year old Labrador. I was nervous that he would not do well being this was his first time at a groomer. Well he did amazing!!! Thank you so much for a great experience!!!

I have an older 12 1/2 yr old majestic mutt. She’s a wash and go pup. She’s older so she’s getting a little smelly quicker than before. I have always groomed her myself. Recently I was unable to bathe her and took her for her very first professional grooming to Pet Parker. She hates baths! The entire staff is friendly and compassionate to animals and my girl did soooo good! The owner, Kristy is hands on and totally awesome. My pup was groomed on 12/30/25 …. today 1/12/26.. she still smells delicious! I will definitely be back.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely amazing experience at Paw Parlor!

I brought in my very dramatic Husky (and any Husky owner knows how intense that can be 😅), and I honestly could not be happier with how everything turned out. From the moment we walked in, the staff was patient, calm, and incredibly professional—exactly what a high-energy, vocal Husky needs.

They handled him with so much care and confidence, even through the dramatics, and never rushed the process. You can tell they genuinely love animals and know how to work with dogs that have big personalities. When I picked him up, he looked absolutely amazing—coat perfectly cleaned and fluffed, shedding under control, and he smelled great without that overpowering “groomer” scent.

Most importantly, he came back happy, relaxed, and clearly well-treated, which says everything. It takes real skill to groom a Husky properly, and Paw Parlor nailed it.

If you’re looking for a groomer who is patient, skilled, and truly cares about your dog—especially if you have a dramatic one like mine—this is the place to go. Highly, highly recommend! 🐺✨

My husband and I decided to take my grandmas cat, so we took it to Pet Pawlour to get it shaved and cleaned up. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful. They went above and beyond for the cat, and we couldn’t be any more grateful for the experience we had at Pet Pawlor. We would truly recommend this place to anyone who is looking for any type of service for their pet.

I can’t say enough good things about Pet Pawlour. I always take my Shih Tzu, Mozart there whenever he needs a groom and have been taking him there for years. I included a before and after pic of him. He’s a very difficult dog to groom and I’m so appreciative of their ability to give him a good haircut despite his negative tendencies of wanting to bite and growl when being handled with scissors and clippers.
If you’re looking for a grooming salon that truly cares about your pet and makes them look their best, Pet Pawlour is the place to go. Thank you for bringing out the handsome gentleman in Mozart!

I took both of my dogs here to be groomed. They were both very scared and  they were treated with compassion and expertise. The salon does a stellar job at such reasonable prices. The owner is a true animal lover and works magic on the animals. I would never go anywhere else!
What a great place, everyone is so friendly and accommodating. They did a beautiful job on my dog. I will definitely be going back.

I've been taking my cat Meep to Pet Pawlour and Kristy for +7 years.  Meep is a very special cat, she generally does not like other felines, she likes most humans, except vets, but she really loves Kristy and her staff.  Anyway after last visit to Pet Pawlour, Kristy pulled me aside and said she noticed Meep seemed excessively thirsty and I should probably bring her in to my vet for some labs.  Well fortunately I did this and the labs showed that Meep was suffering from Diabetes.  We are now treating Meep with medication and she is doing well.  Kristy and staff literally helped save Meep's life just by being really attentive and true cat people.   - thanks Kristy + team!
The best and most reasonable place on the island.  My dog is so happy as soon as she enters the establishment and knows the people.

I believe this is the first time Maria did my baby and she did an amazing job my Canela is perfect I got everything I asked for love this place everybody is very kind and truly care for our babies thank you thank you!!  💕 …

Beware of Maria. This was the worst haircut in history. I am so disappointed with this place, I will never go back. The groomer basically butchered my dog for 75 bucks. I could have done a better job myself. The owner tried to repair the damage done but it was beyond repair. I held back verbal comments because they probably would have called the police if I told them how I really felt. They blamed it on him being a puppy which is a complete joke. I was also told I would get a call 20 minutes before he was ready so he would not be left in a cage long and they waited until he was completely done. Maria pulled him out and ripped a diaper off him, he was a wreck. It will take forever for his hair on his face to grow back and honestly am disgusted. Would not recommend this place and am never going back.

First time in for Astro he was fine he came out not Traumatized all looked good glade to have taken home there new groomer for me
Thank You

I was recommended this place by a few dog moms. This was my Bella Bears first time.
I am happy with the timing and cut.

We recused Marshmallow a while back and she did not like to be groomed. Pet Pawlor was the only place she would cooperate and they always did an amazing job. Marshy has since passed away but even up to the end, she was always well taken care of. Highly recommend Pet Pawlor!!
I must say the greatest groomer around, same day appointment in and out within 20 minutes and was super cheap Kudos to yall

CurlyFries is very happy with his new haircut!
First time … and I already love this place!
100% recommended …

Kenneth, we told you our groomer had knee surgery and is currently recovering and cannot take on any other big dogs and the other groomer is booked with her regulars. Sorry if that was not explained correctly

Pet Pawlour did an excellent job grooming our 2-year-old Shih-Poo! They were quick, attentive, and took great care in making sure he looked his best. He came out looking absolutely adorable, and the pricing was very reasonable. Highly recommend their services!

I was welcomed and greeted by the adorable Feline Staff .. kudo for that!
The crew was polite and professional. My pup was ready in no time.
I recommend and will return !

The haircut alone would be enough to keep me coming back but it’s the staff and how much Benny loves going there that makes this place special. Nothing warms my heart more than him walking right up to the gate like he’s visiting old friends. Thank you, Pet Pawlour- Benny & family

There is nothing like Pet Pawlour. Best groomer I have ever been to. You can trust your pet with them always. Chrissy and her team show the utmost respect to her clients and are always welcoming. Do me a favor, take care of them just like they take care of your animals.

This is my 2nd time taking one of my dogs and I brought my parents 7 year old timid chihuahua with her for his first time. The team here has been so great and understanding of my dogs needs and make me feel 100% comfortable leaving them there. They take their time and don’t rush the process. I have reached out to different groomers on the island who have said “well I can’t give you an estimate until I know how your dog acts” which I understand but PetPawlor was upfront about all fees / expenses. Love love love this group of professionals

Called for dog nail trim. Took me right away and 5 different employees talked and played with him. They gave my Rocco a happy birthday bandana. I ended up knowing the owner Christy from years ago. Always a cool lady. Def recommend. Clean.

I can’t say enough to describe how much i appreciate the hospitality and the kindness that I received at Pet Pawlour my 15 year Shih Tzu is treated with so much care and love. She has been grooming there for over 6 years now but with  age she has become blind and has a few other health issues I love it that they handle her with so much care due to her illnesses thank you to all of you for being there for my dog I truly appreciate you all ♥️
Excellent!! Very good with my dog.

I recently took my puppy to Pet Pawlour
for the first time, and it was an amazing experience! The staff was incredibly welcoming and took the time to make my puppy feel comfortable. They explained the grooming process and answered all my questions, which eased my worries.

When I picked her up, I was thrilled with the results. Her coat was beautifully groomed, and she smelled fantastic! They even added a cute bandana and bow, which made her look extra adorable. It was clear that they genuinely care about the pets they work with. I couldn’t be happier with the service and will definitely be returning for regular grooming. Highly recommend!
